channel.title: Business Today India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: ‘Refrain from dealing’- BSE cautions to investors for this penny stock with zero revenue!
item.description: Leading exchange, BSE Ltd, has cautioned investors for dealing based on multibagger penny stock, through a circular dated Monday, January 23.

item.title: Jharkhand air ambulance crash: Victim's family took ₹8 lakh loan to hire chartered aircraft for his treatment
item.description: The aircraft involved was a Beechcraft C90 operated by Delhi-based charter service Redbird Airways.

item.title: Japan visa update for Indians: Applicants must now schedule appointments in these cities as walk-in system ends
item.description: The new process, introduced by VFS Global, aims to streamline submissions, reduce overcrowding at visa centres, and provide a more organised experience for applicants

item.title: US-Iran tensions: AIMSA writes to PM Modi, seeks early return of students from Tehran
item.description: In its letter, the AIMSA requested the government to ensure safe evacuation and repatriation of stranded Indian students at the earliest.

item.title: SIR in West Bengal: SC permits deployment of civil judges to handle 80 lakh claims, rues 'unfortunate blame game'
item.description: A bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant, along with Justices Joymalya Bagchi and Vipul M Pancholi, took note of a letter from the Calcutta High Court Chief Justice.

item.title: Anthropic accuses DeepSeek and other Chinese rival labs of using Claude to train AI models
item.description: Anthropic stated that these companies used “distillation,” a training method in which a less capable model learns by analysing the outputs of a more advanced one.

item.title: Inside Adani’s $100 billion bet on sovereign AI infrastructure
item.description: Adani’s $100 billion investment focuses on building green-energy-powered AI data centre capacity through AdaniConnex, expanding its current 2-gigawatt footprint toward a target of 5 GW by 2035.

item.title: How India has orchestrated a reset in its trade ties
item.description: How India has orchestrated a reset in its trade ties

item.title: TCS, Infosys, Wipro at risk as AI threatens India’s IT export engine, Citrini report warns
item.description: The model, built on providing skilled engineers at lower wages than their Western counterparts, is under threat as AI coding agents perform similar work at marginal cost, according to the report titled "The 2028 Global Intelligence Crisis."
